toolsPreview.name: get_airport_delay_status
toolsPreview.description: Get live airport-level delay, cancellation, weather flight-rules, and 24-hour forecast context for one airport. Accepts IATA code, city, or airport name. Call this for questions like 'are there delays at JFK' or 'how is Copenhagen airport'. Airport-level only, not flight-number tracking.

toolsPreview.name: airport.get_delay_status
toolsPreview.description: Get live airport-level delay, cancellation, weather flight-rules, and 24-hour forecast context for one airport. Accepts IATA code, city, or airport name. Alias of get_airport_delay_status for clients that prefer dot-notation tool names.

toolsPreview.name: search_supported_airports
toolsPreview.description: Search Pro Flight Search tracked airports when a user's airport reference is ambiguous. Returns matching IATA codes to use with get_airport_delay_status. Call this before airport status when the user says a city name like London or Chicago.

toolsPreview.name: airport.search_supported
toolsPreview.description: Search Pro Flight Search tracked airports when a user's airport reference is ambiguous. Returns matching IATA codes to use with airport.get_delay_status. Alias of search_supported_airports for clients that prefer dot-notation tool names.
